sentences.text: Bane is a fictional supervillain appearing in American comic books published by DC Comics , commonly as an adversary of the superhero Batman .	DC Comics	DC Comics	supervillain	supervillain	superhero	superhero	Batman	Batman

The character first appeared in Batman : Vengeance of Bane # 1 -LRB- January 1993 -RRB- and was created by Chuck Dixon , Doug Moench , and Graham Nolan .	Chuck Dixon	Chuck Dixon	Doug Moench	Doug Moench	Graham Nolan	Graham Nolan	Batman	Batman
With a mix of brute strength and exceptional intelligence , the character is often credited as being the only villain to have `` broken the bat '' .
IGN 's list of the Top 100 Comic Book Villains of All Time ranked Bane as # 34 .	IGN	IGN

Bane was portrayed by Robert Swenson in the 1997 film Batman & Robin , Tom Hardy in the 2012 film The Dark Knight Rises , and was voiced by Doug Benson in the 2017 film The Lego Batman Movie .
